subject: health

location.unitTitle: Health Literacy and Decision Making in High School

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the private-safe task without disclosing medical history, diagnosis, body measurements, or sexual history.
Use a fictional scenario when offered and identify a trusted adult or qualified professional where appropriate.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain what health literacy means at the high-school level in your own words and give a valid example.
Use a cited source, diagram, model, or documented process to show understanding of internal and external influences on a health decision.
Apply source quality: authorship, evidence, currency, and conflict of interest in a new fictional situation. Show the decision process or cite the evidence used.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, or unsafe choice involving a repeatable decision process for health choices; correct it and explain why.
Connect short-term convenience versus longer-term consequence with reviewing a decision after the fact without self-blame. Explain how the two support, constrain, or build on one another.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Work a fictional high-school health decision end to end: name the influences, evaluate two competing sources, run the decision process, and state what evidence would change the decision. The learner never has to use a real decision from their own life.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy of health information criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill application criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. No assessment requires disclosure, a recording, or any body measurement.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Health Literacy and Decision Making in High School?
